method: Direct inspection of eight Flutter widget-test captures in one batch
observations: Math renders as symbols and fractions alongside English and Bengali text.
Markdown emphasis, lists, blockquote, table and literal code remain visible.
Installed cards show verification, size, parameters, Bengali quality, description, speed reason and license.
Delete, pause/cancel, Wi-Fi and catalog controls remain present.
Light/dark captures show readable text and matching theme colors.
limitations: Captured at widget-test level on Linux; no physical-device claim.
Wide and large-text layouts are verified by focused widget tests rather than additional unbounded visual iteration.
